name: #7058: a `moved` row of an item whose body stands nowhere in the head is refused, and a `deleted` row of an item that the check reads as moved is refused

input.body:
## Deletes

|Item|Origin|Act|Why|Future use|In place of deletion|After|Witness|Sign-off|
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
|`v::hom::changed`|#700|moved|—|—|—|`v::directed::changed`|none|—|
|`v::hom::DirectedHom`|#700 (#640)|deleted|a hom|#640; README: none; none found|no consumer|none|none|—|

output:
`v::hom::changed` stands nowhere in the head with the same body, and the row of `v::hom::changed` says `moved`: no item that the head adds has its tokens, so the row says `deleted`, `merged` or `narrowed`, with the architect's sign-off (#7058)
`v::hom::DirectedHom` stands at `v::directed::DirectedHom` with the same body, and its row says `deleted`: the row says `moved`, or it leaves, since the check reads the move (#7058)
the `deleted` row of `v::hom::DirectedHom` has no sign-off: a comment of the architect on the unit names the item and the head commit and says `signed`
